# NainPolicy

> Insurance policy operations API on .NET 10 and SQL Server with optimistic concurrency and an append-only audit trail, plus a live architecture blueprint that replays a real lifecycle run.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://policy.naindev.com/): the interactive blueprint
- [Source code](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/NainPolicy): repository, business rules and documentation
- [Author site](https://www.naindev.com/): Aitor Nain Mendoza Vallejo (NainDev)
